assertion_review.condition_for_failure: Returned or persisted promotion commits differ from canonical ids independently obtained from git; removing prefix normalization instead makes crew.complete raise before these assertions in keyed/mixed cases.
Successful promotion leaves its live pointer.
Promotion rewrites the input manifest; comparison to original input is an intentional immutability check, not a claim about parsing correctness.
Parsing changes list length; this count does not by itself protect prefix normalization and is not relied on as such.
Fixture commit cannot resolve or supposedly absent id exists; these are positive and negative instrument controls.
Promotion accepts the absent id or refuses without naming it; removing the missing-id guard fails pytest.raises.
Refusal no longer identifies an unresolved commit object.
Restoring old diagnostic removes bare commit ids guidance; recorded base control fails here.
Removing keyed-form guidance removes commit: <id> from exception text.
Refusal writes a ledger row or removes the recoverable pointer.
